# Canonical JSON Tool Contract

[1] list_dir
runtime_name: ls
aliases: ls
read_only: true
parallel_safe: true
description: List files in a directory.
examples:
- {"tool":"list_dir","args":{"path":"."}}

[2] read_file
runtime_name: read
aliases: read
read_only: true
parallel_safe: true
description: Read one file. Large files are returned in complete-line pages.
examples:
- {"tool":"read_file","args":{"path":"app.py"}}
- {"tool":"read_file","args":{"path":"app.py","offset":301,"limit":300}}

[3] read_files
runtime_name: -
aliases: -
read_only: true
parallel_safe: false
description: Read up to 8 files in one step. Do not nest it inside parallel.
examples:
- {"tool":"read_files","args":{"paths":["a.py","b.py"]}}

[4] grep
runtime_name: search
aliases: search
read_only: true
parallel_safe: true
description: Search file contents for literal text before reading when the location is unknown. Matching is case-insensitive; regex is not supported.
examples:
- {"tool":"grep","args":{"query":"login handler","path":"."}}

[5] find_references
runtime_name: references
aliases: references
read_only: true
parallel_safe: false
description: Find bounded lexical reference hints for a simple symbol. This is not semantic resolution; use read_file before editing.
examples:
- {"tool":"find_references","args":{"symbol":"createRouter","path":"."}}

[6] parallel
runtime_name: -
aliases: -
read_only: true
parallel_safe: false
description: Batch at most 4 independent read-only list_dir, read_file, or grep calls. Local execution remains sequential.
examples:
- {"tool":"parallel","args":{"calls":[{"tool":"grep","args":{"query":"login","path":"."}},{"tool":"list_dir","args":{"path":"."}}]}}

[7] edit
runtime_name: edit
aliases: -
read_only: false
parallel_safe: false
description: Create a new file with content, or edit an existing file with exact replacements. Up to 8 replacements are validated together and written atomically.
examples:
- {"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"new_app.py","content":"full file contents"}}
- {"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"app.py","old_string":"old exact text","new_string":"new text"}}
- {"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"app.py","replacements":[{"old_string":"old1","new_string":"new1"},{"old_string":"old2","new_string":"new2"}]}}

[8] run
runtime_name: run
aliases: -
read_only: false
parallel_safe: false
description: Run an allowed test, build, lint, or check command.
examples:
- {"tool":"run","args":{"command":"python -m unittest","path":"."}}

[9] shell
runtime_name: shell
aliases: -
read_only: false
parallel_safe: false
description: Ask the user to approve a necessary non-allowlisted command.
examples:
- {"tool":"shell","args":{"command":"git status --short","path":"."}}

[10] done
runtime_name: -
aliases: -
read_only: false
parallel_safe: false
description: Finish the task. summary is the complete user-facing response. For discussion, explanation, or read-only analysis, answer directly instead of merely saying that the topic was discussed.
examples:
- {"tool":"done","args":{"summary":"direct final response to the user"}}

--- rendered prompt contract ---
  {"tool":"list_dir","args":{"path":"."}}
    List files in a directory.

  {"tool":"read_file","args":{"path":"app.py"}}
  {"tool":"read_file","args":{"path":"app.py","offset":301,"limit":300}}
    Read one file. Large files are returned in complete-line pages.

  {"tool":"read_files","args":{"paths":["a.py","b.py"]}}
    Read up to 8 files in one step. Do not nest it inside parallel.

  {"tool":"grep","args":{"query":"login handler","path":"."}}
    Search file contents for literal text before reading when the location is unknown. Matching is case-insensitive; regex is not supported.

  {"tool":"find_references","args":{"symbol":"createRouter","path":"."}}
    Find bounded lexical reference hints for a simple symbol. This is not semantic resolution; use read_file before editing.

  {"tool":"parallel","args":{"calls":[{"tool":"grep","args":{"query":"login","path":"."}},{"tool":"list_dir","args":{"path":"."}}]}}
    Batch at most 4 independent read-only list_dir, read_file, or grep calls. Local execution remains sequential.

  {"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"new_app.py","content":"full file contents"}}
  {"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"app.py","old_string":"old exact text","new_string":"new text"}}
  {"tool":"edit","args":{"path":"app.py","replacements":[{"old_string":"old1","new_string":"new1"},{"old_string":"old2","new_string":"new2"}]}}
    Create a new file with content, or edit an existing file with exact replacements. Up to 8 replacements are validated together and written atomically.

  {"tool":"run","args":{"command":"python -m unittest","path":"."}}
    Run an allowed test, build, lint, or check command.

  {"tool":"shell","args":{"command":"git status --short","path":"."}}
    Ask the user to approve a necessary non-allowlisted command.

  {"tool":"done","args":{"summary":"direct final response to the user"}}
    Finish the task. summary is the complete user-facing response. For discussion, explanation, or read-only analysis, answer directly instead of merely saying that the topic was discussed.
